purpose: Computes perpetual futures funding rates, compound annual APR, and cross-venue funding differential arbitrage (Hyperliquid hourly vs Binance 8-hour cadence). Models delta-neutral carry strategies combining perp short funding with DeFi collateral yield (Ethena sUSDe). Includes basis analytics and Hyperliquid 4%/hr cap note. Not financial advice.
